paper_title: Using the Sun and the Moon as Source masses and the Earth's Rotation as a Modulation to Search for Exotic Spin-Dependent Interactions at Astronomical Distances
suggested_experiment_name: Sun/Moon source with Earth rotation modulation (comagnetometer)
notes: Paper derives limits on scalar-pseudoscalar (g_S^N g_P^n, MonopoleDipole type), VA (g_V g_A) and AA (g_A g_A) neutron-nucleon interactions at astronomical ranges using Sun/Moon as source and Earth rotation modulation, from 3He-129Xe comagnetometer Lorentz-violation data. Primary/most stringent result is on g_S^N g_P^n. X-axis in original plots is interaction range lambda in meters (1e6-1e14 m); converted to mediator mass via m[eV]=1.973e-7/lambda[m]. Text explicitly states |g_S^N g_P^n| < 1.6e-35 (95% CL) for lambda>1e12 m (Sun source). SP interaction range spans ~2e10 m to ~1e14 m. Only asymptotic flat bound explicit in text; full curve shown in Fig 2 not digitized.
